history.value: On the headline setting (starter + sim rewards) pairing between different nets buys only ~1.2x (corr of clears 0.3-0.5, paired end-HP sd 20-22, identical decks in 0-3 of 250 sequences) against ~4x on fixed cell decks (corr 0.8, sd 9-11), because the sim chooser diverges the decks after floor 1; same-net flag variants keep ~2x. MDE at 500 sequences: 0.047 clears / 1.6 HP same-net, 0.06-0.07 / 2.5 HP between nets; the SPRT mostly ends open at the 500 cap for a true +1.0 HP.
